correctness.rationale: Checked graph distances 2 among distinct points; 1/3 for incident/nonincident point-line; 2/4 for nonparallel/parallel lines. Incidence N obeys NN^T=qI+J and N^TN=qI+J-C. The centered quadratic form splits into q parallel-class scalar modes with eigenvalue (q-1)a²-qa, q²-1 paired blocks [-a,(1-b)sqrt(q);(1-b)sqrt(q),-a²], and one constant-population mode; dimensions exhaust N-1. At a=q/(q-1) the scalar is zero, paired determinant a³-q(b-1)² >=0 by b=3^p in [1+3(a-1)/2,2a-1], and remaining mode is strictly negative including q=2 checked separately. For p>p* a parallel-class difference has positive energy; for p<p* Schoenberg strictness follows via Gaussian positive definite kernels. Independently constructed affine planes q=2,3,5 and checked powered-distance centered inertia at/below/above the exact p*. No existence claim for unavailable orders.
